definitions.explanation: The act of displaying works of art, products, or other items for public viewing. Most commonly encountered in the compound {展覧会|てんらんかい} (exhibition).

examples.japanese: ⟦{展覧会|てんらんかい}→展覧会：01470_tenrankai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧。
⟦{美術|びじゅつ}→美術：04447_bijutsu⟧⟦{展覧会|てんらんかい}→展覧会：01470_tenrankai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦チケット→チケット：11014_chiketto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought tickets for an art exhibition.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今回|こんかい}→今回：01409_konkai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{展覧会|てんらんかい}→展覧会：01470_tenrankai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{国内外|こくないがい}→国内外：17208_kokunaigai⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{集|あつ}められた→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧⟦{名画|めいが}→名画：17385_meiga⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{展示|てんじ}→展示：12401_tenji⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This exhibition displays masterpieces gathered from Japan and abroad.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{展|てん}→〜展：28468_ten⟧ (spread out, display) + {覧|らん} (view, look at). Functions as a ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ verb ({展覧|てんらん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ = to exhibit), though the compound ⟦{展覧会|てんらんかい}→展覧会：01470_tenrankai⟧ is far more common.

USAGE:
Rarely used on its own — almost always appears in the compound ⟦{展覧会|てんらんかい}→展覧会：01470_tenrankai⟧ (exhibition, show). The standalone noun {展覧|てんらん} is quite formal and literary. ⟦{展覧会|てんらんかい}→展覧会：01470_tenrankai⟧ is the standard word for art exhibitions, museum shows, and similar public displays.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{展覧会|てんらんかい}→展覧会：01470_tenrankai⟧ — exhibition, show
- ⟦{美術|びじゅつ}→美術：04447_bijutsu⟧⟦{展覧会|てんらんかい}→展覧会：01470_tenrankai⟧ — art exhibition
- ⟦{展覧会|てんらんかい}→展覧会：01470_tenrankai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧ — to hold an exhibition
- ⟦{展覧会|てんらんかい}→展覧会：01470_tenrankai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出品|しゅっぴん}→出品：11726_shuppin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to exhibit (a work) at a show

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{展示|てんじ}→展示：12401_tenji⟧ — display, exhibition (broader, includes permanent displays)
- ⟦{個展|こてん}→個展：15068_koten⟧ — solo exhibition (one artist's show)
- ⟦{博覧会|はくらんかい}→博覧会：29493_hakurankai⟧ — exposition, world's fair (large-scale, often international)
